sourceRecord.sourceWikitext:
{{Recipe summary | Category = Fruit recipes | Difficulty = 1 | Image = [[File:Ensaladadefruta.jpg|300px]] }} {{recipe}} This '''fruit salad''' is a [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]] that is very popular and traditional at Christmas time in Uruguay. It's normally served all throughout the summer as it is very refreshing and makes a few fruits go a long way. == Ingredients == * 1 can (400 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Peach|peaches]] (in natural juice) * 1 can (150 g) [[Cookbook:Pineapple|pineapple]] pieces (in natural juice) * 200 g [[Cookbook:Cherry|cherries]] * 200 g seedless [[Cookbook:Grape|grapes]] (any type) * 1 red [[Cookbook:Apple|apple]] * 1 large [[Cookbook:Orange|orange]] * 1 [[Cookbook:Nectarine|nectarine]] * 2 [[Cookbook:Plum|plums]] * 1 large [[Cookbook:Banana|banana]] * 2 [[Cookbook:Passion Fruit|passion fruits]] * 1 small container of [[Cookbook:Strawberry|strawberries]] * 1.25 [[Cookbook:Liter|L]] (or less) Fanta orange [[Cookbook:Soda Pop|soda]], chilled == Procedure == # Place canned fruit in a large bowl along with its juice, making sure you cut the peaches into small pieces. # Wash remaining fruit thoroughly. # Place cherries and grapes (minus stalks and any leaves) in the bowl. # Cut up remaining fruit into small pieces, place in the bowl, and chill. # Prior to serving, mix lightly and cover with chilled Fanta. # Serve with a slotted spoon for a lovely summer dessert, especially during the holidays when we need a stomach cool down after a heavy meal. == Notes, tips, and variations == * Any of the fruits above can be omitted.
